subject: storytime
title: Magic Tree House words
about: Jack and Annie find a tree house full of books in the woods, make a wish, and are whirled back to the time of the dinosaurs, where they have to find their way home before dark. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read a chapter together each night.

book.author: Mary Pope Osborne
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: The first Magic Tree House chapter book, where a wish sends two kids back to the dinosaurs.

ou says ow, like in out; se says s, the e is silent

oo says oo as in look

all regular; n-d at the end: the wind blows
three parts: di-no-saur; i and o say their names and au says aw: dy-no-sor

all regular; s-t at the end
